description: Wait for a script run to finish and return its result. If it is still running when the wait ends, the reply has wait_timed_out: true — call again. A finished run whose calls wait for approval asks for them here when this client can show a form.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the script to finish before returning. Defaults to, and is capped at, 300 s when your client accepts a streamed reply (text/event-stream), 90 s otherwise. The script keeps going when the wait ends first.

name: wait_for_script_run

outputSchema.description: One script run on the account's computer.

approvals.description: What the script's gated calls froze, as each stands now.

items.description: A gated action, frozen as it was called, and where it stands. Approving runs it once: then `result` or `error` holds the outcome.

reason.description: Why it was denied, or that it expired.

artifacts.description: Files the script wrote to outputDir.

items.description: A file the work produced. Exchange its id for a download link with get_file_download_url.

calls.description: Every tool call the script made, in order.

approval_id.description: Set on a 202: the approval this call is waiting for.

output.description: What the script printed: its start and end when long, with the cut marked.

pending_approval_ids.description: Approvals still waiting for a decision: answer them with resolve_approvals.

result.description: The script's last expression, as JSON.

wait_timed_out.description: The wait ended first. The work is still running: follow it with the tool next_step names.
